title: Sights Tour and Tabernacle Choir in Salt Lake City
includes: Dining and attraction discounts (10–50% at participating partners)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the cultural heart of Salt Lake City with a guided tour of its iconic landmarks followed by a live performance by the world-renowned Tabernacle Choir. This 2-hour experience begins with a short ride on a closed-top double-decker bus, showcasing sites like the Utah State Capitol and Temple Square. Enjoy insightful commentary as you learn about the city's rich history. The morning concludes with an inspiring performance at the historic Tabernacle, making it a perfect outing for music enthusiasts and culture seekers. After the performance, guests are welcome to rejoin the Hop On Hop Off bus at Stop #12 – FamilySearch Library starting at 11:15 AM to continue exploring the city at their own pace.

Note that the Tabernacle Choir performance is free and open to the public. We will be registering our guests for tickets so that you don't need to register for it.
